profile.summary: Third-year Computer Science student seeking AI Engineering internship opportunities. Experienced in building LLM-powered applications, fine-tuning language models with Py Torch and Lo RA, and integrating AI services with Python APIs and microservice-based systems. Strong interest in applying machine learning and backend engineering to practical AIproducts.

project_evidence: Independently designed and built a customer support chatbot system using a microservices architecture with Fast API, gRPC, and Streamlit. Fine-tuned a Qwen large language model using PyTorch and PEFT/LoRA for banking intent recognition. Integrated an API Gateway with Ollama to generate natural, domain-specific responses for banking scenarios. Containerized and deployed the system using Docker Compose to streamline the operational workflow.

Contributed to the frontend and part of the backend in a team project building a Zoom-like web app with video calling, screen sharing, virtual backgrounds, chat, and file sharing. Integrated WebRTC and Video SDK for real-time media streaming; used Socket.io to synchronize room state and messaging across participants. Implemented meeting recording, transcription, and AI-powered summarization after each session.

history.institution: Ho Chi Minh City University of Science (HCMUS)
